entries.en: You got blood on my shoes!
W-wait, please! I-I-I didn't see or hear nothin', I swear!
entries.ro: S-stai, te rog! N-am văzut și n-am auzit nimic, jur!

entries.en: Why was he beating on you?
Why was he beating on you?
entries.en_m: Why was he beatin' on you?

entries.en: 'Cause he's a fuckin' psycho like all the rest of 'em! Thank Christ you came – taught him a lesson.
entries.ro: Pentru că e un psihopat nenorocit, ca toți ceilalți! Slavă Domnului că ai venit – i-ai dat o lecție.

entries.en: Nothin'! I wa-- I was set up!
entries.ro: Nimic! Am fo-- am fost înscenat!

entries.en: I-- I-I don't know, I-- They all look the fucking same! There's one downstairs – I know that.
entries.ro: N-nu știu, toți arată la fel, pula mea! E unul jos, asta știu.

entries.en: Good. Cell's open. Do what you want.
entries.ro: Bine. Celula e deschisă. Fă ce vrei.

entries.en: And what'd you get canned for?
entries.ro: Și pe tine pentru ce te-au închis?
